$description: Gesture motion (library plan wave 2, foundation gesture): the distances, times and rates that turn pointer and touch movement into gestures, and the motion an element makes when a gesture ends. hooks/useGesture.js reads them; system/gesture.css draws the settle.

gesture-slop.$description: How far a pointer may move before a press becomes a pan: under it a tap or a long press, over it the movement is tracked (and a long press is canceled).

gesture-swipe-distance.$description: The distance along the swipe's axis that commits a swipe when the pointer is released slowly; a release faster than the fling velocity commits it sooner.

gesture-fling-velocity.$description: The release speed, in CSS pixels per millisecond, at and above which a pan ends as a fling (and commits a swipe whatever its distance).

gesture-fling-decay.$description: How much of its speed a flung element keeps each millisecond (the deceleration rate of a scroll view): the distance it travels is velocity × decay ÷ (1 − decay).

gesture-long-press-delay.$description: How long a pointer is held still before a long press: the touch long-press delay, so every long press in the Platform waits the same.

gesture-pull-distance.$description: Pull to refresh: the pull (after resistance) at which releasing refreshes; under it the pull springs back.

gesture-pull-resistance.$description: Pull to refresh: the share of the finger's movement the pulled content follows, so the pull feels heavier than a scroll.

gesture-pinch-max-scale.$description: Pinch to zoom: the largest scale a pinch reaches (four times); the smallest is the element's fitted size, 1.

gesture-settle-duration.$description: When a gesture ends the element settles where it lands (committed) or springs back (canceled) over this time.

gesture-settle-easing.$description: The settle's easing: it leaves at the finger's speed and decelerates into place, without overshoot or bounce.
